newsitem.title: USA: One killed, another feared dead in Yellowstone.
newsitem.headline: One killed, another feared dead in Yellowstone.

text.p: One geologist was killed and another feared dead in an avalanche in Yellowstone National Park, officials said Thursday.
The body of Roderick Hutchinson, who worked more than 25 years at the famed park, was found Thursday after a two day search.
Rescue workers were still looking for a visiting seismic geologist, whose name is being withheld pending notification of relatives.
Hutchinson wrote widely on the park's unique geological aspects, officials said.
